title: Claude Code
summary: Anthropic's Claude Code driven by agentd's built-in adapter. The vendor's CLI is installed separately.
description: A first-party descriptor of one of agentd's built-in harness adapters (design 73 section 8, D1464). The listing describes Loams' adapter, which is Apache-2.0 and ships inside loams-agentd; the vendor's CLI is installed separately (Settings can run the vendor's official installer) and found on PATH or through its `*_EXECUTABLE` override. The vendor's software is separate, under its own licence and terms. agentd launches it as `claude --print --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json` and drives its stream-json protocol, adding per-run flags (model, effort, permission mode, resume).
